decision: The real current Native CLI LLVM uses the same exact instance-owned sollang_fn_std_crypto_aes128_Key_encryptBlock identity as CSharp. The old native check demanded historical numeric module/symbol identities. Require the single canonical identity on both sides, keeping kernel counts, optional instruction isolation, dispatch and receiver checks unchanged.
executionChoice: Repeat only these small focused fixture commands with the corrected consumer; no Native compiler build or Stage build. A new replay API would add more validation and maintenance than these bounded runs.
